title: Asteroids Survivor telemetry event
description: Frozen 2026-09-11. Every client event sent via navigator.sendBeacon() to VITE_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT MUST validate against this schema. No changes after 2026-09-11 without a new plan.

session_id.description: Opaque per-tab random id (UUID v4). Not a user id, not persisted across runs.

event_name.description: Closed set for the MVP increment.

properties.description: Event-scoped numeric/boolean/string facts only. No free text, no user-supplied content, no identifiers.

survived_ms.description: death: milliseconds survived on the run that just ended.

high_score_ms.description: death / continue_click: best survived_ms stored in IndexedDB.

returning.description: session_start: true when IndexedDB already holds a previous run.
